answer: A newcomer asked to join my circle. I asked for three opal receipts, one per client, each with the client's ivory seal and a week old. A farm can buy receipts at $45 a job, but I call each client, and a bought one fails once in three. One failure voids the set, so a fake passes all three only 30% of the time, and each failed try burns $135. A newcomer pays in time, a first week of micro-jobs that barely pay. A plume of real work can't be printed overnight.
